neighbours.label: the token ' lung' in 'black lung' (coal miners' disease)
fire: After thirty years underground, the miner was diagnosed with black lung.
Benefits for coal workers suffering from black lung were cut last year.
Doctors in Kentucky report a surge in severe black lung among young miners.
His father died of black lung after decades in the Appalachian pits.
The union fought for better screening for black lung in mining towns.
X-rays revealed advanced black lung in nearly a tenth of the workers.
Many retired miners still wait for their black lung compensation claims.
The clinic in West Virginia treats hundreds of black lung patients.
